name: 10-negative-balance-protection
why: balance 500, loss -1000 -> stop-out drives the balance to -500. Broker has negativeBalanceProtection=true: web floors the balance at 0 and books a +500 NEGATIVE_BALANCE_PROTECTION write-off.

knownDivergence.note: Rust prices used margin at OPEN price (calc.rs used_margin), web at LIVE close-side price (lib/margin.ts liveUsedMarginFor); the level number differs, the decision does not.
